name: swarm
description: SWARM — a real-time multi-agent AI orchestrator with a mission-control dashboard

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
